item.title: iPhone Duo 开启全球限购，每位顾客最多买 2 台
item.guid: iPhone-Duo-开启全球限购，每位顾客最多买-2-台
item.description:
Apple's official website shows that the iPhone Duo, originally scheduled for release on October 23, is currently limited to 2 units per customer. 苹果官网显示，原定 10 月 23 日发售的 iPhone Duo 目前每位顾客限购 2 台。

Pre-orders for the iPhone Duo began at 8 PM on October 16th across online channels including Apple's official website, Apple Store App, and Apple Tmall flagship store. During the pre-sale period, the influx of traffic was so large that platforms experienced temporary slowdowns. Reports indicate that in-store pickup inventory sold out on the first day of release, and delivery times for some online orders have been pushed back to late January next year. The domestic starting price for the device is 15,999 yuan. iPhone Duo 于 10 月 16 日晚 8 点在苹果官网、Apple Store App、苹果天猫旗舰店等线上渠道开启预售。预售期间涌入量过大，平台一度卡顿。报道称，首发当日到店取货库存已售罄，部分线上订单的配送时间已推迟至明年 1 月下旬。该机国行起售价为 15999 元。

In the secondary market, according to China News Service Economic Daily, minutes after pre-orders opened, transaction prices for multiple versions of the iPhone Duo on the Dewu platform exceeded 20,000 yuan. The average transaction price for the 1TB black version was 28,642 yuan, 7,143 yuan higher than the official price; the 256GB black version's average transaction price was 22,085 yuan, an increase of 6,086 yuan, or approximately 38.0%. 二级市场上，据中新经纬报道，预售开启几分钟后，得物平台上 iPhone Duo 多个版本的成交价突破 2 万元。其中 1TB 黑色版本成交均价为 28642 元，比官方售价高出 7143 元；256GB 黑色版本成交均价为 22085 元，上涨 6086 元，涨幅约 38.0%。

However, third-party channel prices have now significantly dropped, with several scalpers on second-hand trading platforms only adding 3,000 yuan and promising delivery on the first day of sale. 不过，目前第三方渠道报价已大幅回落，多位黄牛在二手交易平台上仅加价 3000 元，并承诺首销当天拿货。

item.title: PHP 紧急修复两个严重漏洞，攻击者无需登录即可远程执行代码
item.guid: PHP-紧急修复两个严重漏洞，攻击者无需登录即可远程执行代码
item.description:
The PHP development team has released an urgent security update to fix two critical vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. Attackers could remotely execute code without authentication through specially crafted network requests; official sources confirm that in Apache mod_php scenarios, attacks can even be triggered before application code runs. PHP 开发团队发布紧急安全更新，修复 CVE-2026-109618 和 CVE-2026-109619 两个严重漏洞。攻击者可能通过特制网络请求，在无需身份验证的情况下远程执行代码；官方确认，在 Apache mod_php 场景中，攻击甚至可在应用代码运行前触发。

Attackers may not need an account or password; they can remotely execute code simply by sending specially crafted requests to the affected server. The vulnerability exists in the PHP core request processing flow and does not rely on flaws in website applications like WordPress or Drupal themselves. 攻击者可能无需账号或密码，只需向受影响的服务器发送特制请求，就能远程执行代码。漏洞存在于 PHP 核心请求处理流程中，不依赖 WordPress、Drupal 等网站应用本身存在缺陷。

Once the vulnerability is successfully exploited, it could allow for code execution within the permissions of the PHP worker process, website modification, or reading sensitive information such as passwords, authentication tokens, and API keys from process memory. 一旦成功利用漏洞，就可能在 PHP 工作进程的权限范围内执行代码、修改网站，或读取进程内存中的密码、身份验证令牌和 API 密钥等敏感信息。

The patched versions are PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, and 8.2.35. Officials emphasize that temporary mitigation measures can only reduce the risk of some attack paths, and updating is the complete solution; PHP 8.1 and older versions no longer receive regular security updates from the project, and users need to check their distribution or long-term support vendor for patch packages. 修复版本为 PHP 8.5.12、8.4.27、8.3.36 和 8.2.35。官方强调，临时缓解措施只能降低部分攻击路径的风险，更新才是完整解决办法；PHP 8.1 及更旧版本已不再获得项目常规安全更新，使用者需核对发行版或长期支持供应商的修复包。

OpenAI stated that Calif discovered a vulnerability in the Patch the Planet program with the help of GPT-5.6 Sol, and Wiz also independently found and reported two issues. Maintainers, research teams, infrastructure, and security service providers have been coordinating for about two months to prepare for fixes and protections before disclosure. OpenAI 表示，Calif 在 Patch the Planet 计划中借助 GPT-5.6 Sol 发现其中一处漏洞，Wiz 也独立发现并报告了两处问题。维护者与研究团队、基础设施及安全服务商已协调约两个月，为披露前的修复和防护做准备。

item.title: 三星、SK 海力士升级中国工厂，拟转产更高层数 NAND
item.guid: 三星、SK-海力士升级中国工厂，拟转产更高层数-NAND
item.description:
According to Reuters, Samsung and SK Hynix are upgrading their respective NAND flash factories in China to cope with competition from YMTC and demand from AI data centers. Both companies confirmed they are installing or upgrading equipment and stated they are maintaining communication with the U.S. government. 据路透社报道，三星和 SK 海力士正升级各自在中国的 NAND 闪存工厂，以应对长江存储的竞争及 AI 数据中心需求。两家公司均确认正在安装或升级设备，并称与美国政府保持沟通。

Samsung's Xi'an factory plans to switch to producing 286-layer V9 NAND. Insiders say the project aims to achieve a monthly output of 5,000 wafers by December this year, increasing to 40,000 wafers by December 2027. The Xi'an factory accounts for about 40% of Samsung's global NAND production and currently mainly produces approximately 200-layer products. Samsung emphasized that this is a technological upgrade and does not involve adding new capacity or building new factories. 三星西安工厂拟转产 286 层 V9 NAND。知情人士称，该项目计划今年 12 月实现每月 5000 片晶圆产出，2027 年 12 月增至 4 万片。西安工厂约占三星全球 NAND 产量的 40%，目前主要生产约 200 层产品。三星强调，这次属于技术升级，不涉及新增产能或建设新工厂。

SK Hynix plans to upgrade its Dalian factory's products from 192 layers to 240 layers or more. An insider said the company might further apply to develop technology for over 300 layers locally, preparing for future production in the United States. SK 海力士则拟将大连工厂的产品从 192 层升级至 240 层或以上。一名知情人士称，公司可能进一步申请在当地研发 300 层以上技术，为未来在美国生产做准备。

Both companies need to apply for annual permits to install US equipment in China. Reuters has not yet confirmed the specific scope of equipment approved by the US for this upgrade; the US Commerce Department reiterated that its previous policy supports the operation of existing factories but not expansion or technological upgrades. 两家公司在中国安装美国设备需逐年申请许可。路透尚未确认美国已批准此次升级所需设备的具体范围；美国商务部重申，此前政策支持现有工厂运行，但不支持扩产或技术升级。

item.title: 雷军：汽车产业如果没有安全，其他都是 0
item.guid: 雷军：汽车产业如果没有安全，其他都是-0
item.description:
On October 21, Xiaomi Auto's Beijing Design Center was officially opened. Lei Jun stated on the same day at the World Intelligent Connected Vehicles Conference that if the automotive industry lacks safety, everything else is zero; all intelligent features and innovative designs lose their meaning. Xiaomi has attached great importance to safety since the first day of car manufacturing. 10 月 21 日，小米汽车北京设计中心正式启用。雷军同日在世界智能网联汽车大会上表示，汽车产业如果没有安全，其他都是 0；所有的智能性能和创新设计都失去了意义。小米从造车第一天起就高度重视安全。

Speaking of the next stage of intelligent connected vehicles, Lei Jun believes that competition will increasingly revolve around ecosystems. He proposed that China, with its complete industrial chain, active AI innovation atmosphere, and vast single market, has the opportunity to connect the entire intelligent ecosystem and forge a Chinese-style innovation path. 谈到智能网联汽车的下一阶段，雷军认为，竞争将更多围绕生态展开。他提出，中国拥有完备的产业链、活跃的 AI 创新氛围和庞大的单一市场，有机会把整个智能生态连接起来，走出中国式的创新路径。

Taking Xiaomi's consumer IoT platform as an example, Lei Jun stated that as of the end of the second quarter, the number of connected devices had exceeded 1.1 billion. To improve the ecosystem experience, Xiaomi continues to invest in underlying technologies such as chips, operating systems, and AI embodied intelligence; its hard-core technology R&D investment over the past 5 years was 105.5 billion yuan, and related investment is expected to exceed 200 billion yuan in the next 5 years. 雷军以小米的消费级 IoT 平台为例称，截至二季度末，设备连接数已超过 11 亿台。为了完善生态体验，小米持续投入芯片、操作系统和 AI 具身智能等底层技术；过去 5 年硬核科技研发投入为 1055 亿元，预计未来 5 年相关投入将超过 2000 亿元。

Xiaomi Pengcheng's official account stated that the Pengcheng Auto Design Exhibition has opened to the public, and the Beijing Auto Design Center has also welcomed its first public opening since its completion. Lei Jun later reposted the blog post, confirming that the design center has been officially launched and expressed plans to visit. 小米澎程官方账号称，澎程汽车设计展已面向公众开幕，北京汽车设计中心也迎来建成后的首次对外开放。雷军随后转发博文，确认设计中心已正式启用，并表示计划前往参观。

item.title: 宝马员工争相离职挤崩系统，个别方案补偿超 65 万欧元
item.guid: 宝马员工争相离职挤崩系统，个别方案补偿超-65-万欧元
item.description:
BMW's voluntary severance package was 'overwhelmed' and has stopped accepting new applications ahead of schedule. According to Germany's Handelsblatt reported on October 20, thousands of employees have expressed their intention to leave since it opened on October 8. BMW confirmed that the target has been reached ahead of schedule and plans to complete the scheme processing by mid-next month. 宝马的自愿离职补偿被「挤爆」，已提前停止接受新申请。据德国《商报》10 月 20 日报道，自 10 月 8 日开放以来，已有数千名员工表达离职意愿，宝马确认目标已提前达到，计划在下月中旬前完成方案处理。

Previously, tens of thousands of employees received compensation invitations, and a large number of employees simultaneously logged in to view their individual plans, which caused the internal HR portal to crash for several hours before the system recovered the next day. Expressing an intention to leave does not equate to being approved for departure; this plan requires voluntary agreement from both the employee and the employer. 此前，数万名员工收到补偿邀请，大量员工同时登录查看个人方案，曾使内部人力资源门户瘫痪数小时，系统于次日恢复。员工表达意愿不等于获准离职，这项计划要求员工与雇主双方自愿同意。

Individual compensation packages disclosed by Handelsblatt exceeded 650,000 euros, mainly involving more senior and higher-paid employees, and should not be considered a universal standard. A full report from Motor1 shows that the packages can combine methods such as one-time payments, installments, pensions, and insurance, and some employees can still retain car purchase discounts after leaving. 《商报》披露的个别补偿方案超过 65 万欧元，主要涉及资历较深、薪资较高的员工，不能视为普遍标准。Motor1 的完整报道显示，方案可结合一次性付款、分期、养老金及保险等方式，部分员工离职后仍可保留购车优惠。

BMW aims to cut approximately 8,000 jobs by the end of 2027. 宝马目标是在 2027 年底前减少约 8000 个岗位。

item.title: Today AI 累计融资超 2 亿美元，腾讯、蚂蚁等参投
item.guid: Today-AI-累计融资超-2-亿美元，腾讯、蚂蚁等参投
item.description:
According to Leidi reports, Today AI announced on October 21 that its team has cumulatively completed over $200 million in financing, with investors including IDG Capital, Tencent, 5Y Capital, Ant Group, Sequoia China, Transsion Holdings, Tongge Ventures, and Shanghai Jiao Tong University Hanyuan Asset. 据雷递报道，Today AI 于 10 月 21 日宣布，团队累计完成超过 2 亿美元融资，投资方包括 IDG 资本、腾讯、五源资本、蚂蚁集团、红杉中国、传音控股、同歌创投及上海交大菡源资产。

Today AI was founded by Qi Junyuan, founder of Teambition and former head of Doubao PC. It specializes in personalized, proactive AI assistants. The product has been launched in China and can handle tasks such as schedule management, data research, work assistance, and personal note-taking. Today AI 由 Teambition 创始人、前豆包 PC 端负责人齐俊元创办，主打个性化、主动式 AI 助理。产品已在国内上线，可承担日程管理、资料研究、工作协助和随身记录等任务。

According to Zhidx.com reports, Today supports iOS, Android, Windows, Mac, and Linux, and can connect to applications such as WeChat Work, WeChat Reading, Baidu Netdisk, Kingsoft Docs, and Tencent Meeting. The team hopes to accumulate user memory through continuous interaction and provide assistance before users even articulate their needs. 据智东西报道，Today 支持 iOS、安卓、Windows、Mac 和 Linux，并可连接企业微信、微信读书、百度网盘、金山文档、腾讯会议等应用。团队希望通过持续交互积累用户记忆，在用户提出需求前提供协助。

item.title: OpenAI 模型将入驻谷歌云，企业可用云消费承诺购买
item.guid: OpenAI-模型将入驻谷歌云，企业可用云消费承诺购买
item.description:
OpenAI and Google Cloud announced a partnership to integrate cutting-edge models and Codex agent workflows into Google Cloud's Model Garden, with a full rollout planned in the coming weeks. OpenAI 与 Google Cloud 宣布合作，将前沿模型和 Codex 智能体工作流接入谷歌云的 Model Garden，计划在未来几周全面开放。

Enterprises can purchase these models through Google Cloud Marketplace, and the costs can be offset against existing Google Cloud consumption commitments. Both parties will combine the models' capabilities with Google Cloud's access control, centralized data governance, and infrastructure for software development and complex agent tasks. 企业可通过 Google Cloud Marketplace 购买这些模型，费用可抵扣既有的谷歌云消费承诺。双方将把模型能力与谷歌云的访问控制、集中式数据治理和基础设施结合，用于软件开发及复杂的智能体任务。

OpenAI also stated that its models will soon be available in Google Antigravity and Gemini Agent, allowing enterprises to choose models from different companies within these tools. Microsoft remains OpenAI's primary cloud partner. OpenAI 还表示，其模型将很快进入 Google Antigravity 和 Gemini Agent，让企业在这些工具中选择不同公司的模型。微软仍是 OpenAI 的主要云合作伙伴。

item.title: 英伟达把 AI 工厂装进集装箱，DSX POD 最快 14 天部署
item.guid: 英伟达把-AI-工厂装进集装箱，DSX-POD-最快-14-天部署
item.description:
Nvidia launched DSX POD at the GTC Berlin conference: partners will build complete Vera Rubin AI factories within modular containers, integrated and validated before leaving the factory, with global delivery planned for early 2027. 英伟达在 GTC 柏林大会推出 DSX POD：由合作伙伴在模块化集装箱内建造完整的 Vera Rubin AI 工厂，出厂前完成集成和验证，计划 2027 年初在全球交付。

According to Nvidia, assuming site power, cooling, networking, and other supporting facilities are ready, this solution can reduce on-site deployment time from 6 months to as fast as 14 days. The installation and testing of computing, networking, cabling, rack power, and liquid cooling are moved to the manufacturing factory, running in parallel with site preparation. 按英伟达的说法，在场地电力、冷却、网络等配套已准备好的前提下，这套方案可将现场部署时间从 6 个月缩短至最快 14 天。计算、网络、布线、机架供电和液冷的安装及测试被前移到制造工厂，与场地准备并行进行。

Participating partners include Dell, HPE, Lenovo, Schneider Electric, and Vertiv, among others. Jensen Huang stated that the point at which an AI factory begins to generate value is when it's put into model training or production inference, generating tokens. DSX POD aims to compress the time between delivery and official operation. 参与伙伴包括戴尔、惠普企业、联想、施耐德电气和维谛技术等。黄仁勋表示，AI 工厂开始产生价值的节点是投入模型训练或生产推理、生成 token，DSX POD 希望压缩的正是交付后到正式运行之间的时间。

item.title: 中办、国办：全面实施「人工智能+」行动，支持企业主导成果转化
item.guid: 中办、国办：全面实施「人工智能+」行动，支持企业主导成果转化
item.description:
The General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the "Opinions on Promoting Deep Integration of Scientific and Technological Innovation with Industrial Innovation," proposing to fully implement the "AI+" action to empower all industries with artificial intelligence. 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅发布《关于推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合的意见》，提出全面实施「人工智能+」行动，推动人工智能全方位赋能千行百业。

The "Opinions" call for accelerating the innovative development of industrial internet, using advanced technology to transform traditional industries; exploring technology routes, application scenarios, and business models in cutting-edge fields such as quantum technology, brain-computer interfaces, embodied AI, and 6G, and promoting industrialization and commercialization. 《意见》要求加速工业互联网创新发展，以先进技术改造传统产业；在量子科技、脑机接口、具身智能、6G 等前沿领域探索技术路线、应用场景和商业模式，推进产业化、商业化。

Regarding achievement transformation, national science and technology plan projects with clear industrial application goals are generally led by enterprises for implementation and achievement transformation. Universities and research institutes are encouraged to license scientific and technological achievements to small and medium-sized enterprises on a pay-per-use basis. At the same time, the document proposes promoting the improvement of laws and regulations in cutting-edge fields such as artificial intelligence and biotechnology, and exploring "sandbox regulation" methods. 在成果转化上，产业应用目标明确的国家科技计划项目原则上由企业牵头实施并主导成果转化，鼓励高校、科研院所按照先使用后付费方式向中小微企业许可科技成果。同时，文件提出推动健全人工智能、生物技术等前沿领域法律法规，探索「沙盒监管」方式。

item.title: 曝DeepSeek 近 1000 亿元新融资接近完成
item.guid: 曝DeepSeek-近-1000-亿元新融资接近完成
item.description:
According to Leidi's report, DeepSeek's new round of nearly 100 billion yuan financing is nearing completion, with a pre-investment valuation of approximately 500 billion yuan. The report cited sources saying that both Lisi Xingshen and Shixiang Shangshi funds participated in this round of investment, and Tencent also continued to follow suit. 据雷递报道，DeepSeek 新一轮近 1000 亿元融资接近完成，投前估值约 5000 亿元。报道援引知情人士称，砺思星深、拾象尚势两只基金均参与本轮投资，腾讯也继续跟投。

Perfect World's disclosed fund progress announcement shows that Lisi Xingshen has completed fundraising, with a total scale of 7.52 billion yuan, and the company subscribed 50 million yuan; Shixiang Shangshi fund has a total scale of 3.65 billion yuan, and the company subscribed 100 million yuan. 完美世界披露的基金进展公告显示，砺思星深已募集完毕，总规模为 75.2 亿元，公司认缴 5000 万元；拾象尚势基金总规模为 36.5 亿元，公司认缴 1 亿元。

According to information obtained by Leidi, new investors in this round are mainly industrial capital, including Shixi Capital, SMIC Juyuan, CPE Yuanfeng, Legend Capital, and Geely, while existing shareholders such as CATL, Tencent, IDG Capital, Lisi Capital, and Shixiang Capital continued to follow suit. 按雷递获得的信息，本轮新进投资者以产业资本为主，包括石溪资本、中芯聚源、CPE 源峰、君联资本和吉利等，宁德时代、腾讯、IDG 资本、砺思资本和拾象资本等老股东继续跟投。

item.title: Codex 推出永久对话缓存
item.guid: Codex-推出永久对话缓存
item.description:
Tibo Sottiaux, OpenAI's Head of Product, announced that the API now offers a 12-hour prompt cache option; for logged-in users of Codex and Work, the company will permanently retain the cache. Users can hit the cache when returning to old conversations or continuing after several hours of interruption. OpenAI 产品负责人 Tibo Sottiaux 宣布，API 现可选择 12 小时提示缓存；对 Codex 和 Work 的已登录用户，公司会永久保留缓存。用户回到旧对话，或中断数小时后继续，也可命中缓存。

The OpenAI Developers announcement explained that long-running agents repeatedly use the same context throughout the day. The new option allows shared instructions, tools, and context to be retained longer, and even if requests are several hours apart, they can still be billed at a lower cached input rate. OpenAI Developers 的公告解释，长期运行的智能体会在一天中反复使用相同上下文。新选项可让共享指令、工具和上下文保留更久，即使两次请求间隔数小时，仍可按较低的缓存输入费率计费。

Tibo listed this change as a "Day 16" update and stated that resuming old sessions would not incur additional penalties. Tibo 将这项变化列为「第 16 天」更新，并表示恢复旧会话不会受到额外惩罚。

item.title: 特斯拉三季度净利润下降 43%，自由现金流转正
item.guid: 特斯拉三季度净利润下降-43%，自由现金流转正
item.description:
Tesla announced its Q3 2026 financial report, with revenue of $28.046 billion, largely flat year-over-year; GAAP net income attributable to common shareholders was $787 million, a 43% decrease year-over-year. The company delivered 486,532 vehicles in the quarter, a 2% decrease year-over-year. 特斯拉公布 2026 年第三季度财报，营收 280.46 亿美元，与上年同期基本持平；归属普通股股东的 GAAP 净利润为 7.87 亿美元，同比下降 43%。公司当季交付 486532 辆车，同比下降 2%。

Several sets of data present the business and expenditure changes for this quarter: 几组数据呈现了本季的业务与支出变化：

    Automotive business revenue was $20.560 billion, a 3% decrease year-over-year; energy storage business revenue was $2.881 billion, a 16% decrease; services and other business revenue was $4.605 billion, a 33% increase.

    GAAP operating profit was $718 million, a 56% decrease year-over-year, with an operating margin of 2.6%; diluted EPS was $0.22, and non-GAAP diluted EPS was $0.48.

    Capital expenditure was $4.732 billion, lower than the previous quarter's $5.789 billion; operating cash flow was $6.263 billion, and free cash flow was $1.531 billion, turning positive from a negative value in the previous quarter.

The company stated that over three-quarters of new vehicle deliveries in North America came with FSD subscriptions, and the global active FSD subscriptions reached 1.74 million, including one-time purchases and monthly subscriptions, but excluding free trials. Tesla also emphasized that FSD still requires active driver supervision. Cybercab joined Robotaxi service in Austin on September 3, and Tesla Semi and Optimus have also begun production in Nevada and Fremont, respectively. 公司称，北美新车交付中超过四分之三附带 FSD 订阅，全球活跃 FSD 订阅数达 174 万，口径包括一次性购买与月订阅，不含免费试用。特斯拉同时强调，FSD 仍需驾驶员主动监督。Cybercab 已于 9 月 3 日在奥斯汀加入 Robotaxi 服务，Tesla Semi 和 Optimus 也已分别在内华达和弗里蒙特开始生产。

item.title: IBM 软件业务增长回升，上调全年自由现金流预期
item.guid: IBM-软件业务增长回升，上调全年自由现金流预期
item.description:
IBM announced its Q3 2026 results, with revenue of $17.103 billion, an increase of approximately 5% year-over-year, or 6% at constant currency. GAAP net income from continuing operations was $2.199 billion, up 26%; diluted EPS was $2.31, and operating non-GAAP EPS was $2.95. IBM 公布 2026 年第三季度业绩，营收 171.03 亿美元，同比增长约 5%，按固定汇率计算增长 6%。持续经营业务 GAAP 净利润为 21.99 亿美元，增长 26%；相应摊薄每股收益为 2.31 美元，经营口径非 GAAP 每股收益为 2.95 美元。

Software business revenue was approximately $7.8 billion, an 8% increase year-over-year. Within this, Red Hat grew by 11%, data business by 19%, and automation business decreased by 3%. Consulting business revenue was approximately $5.3 billion, largely flat year-over-year; infrastructure business revenue was approximately $3.7 billion, up 4%, but IBM Z mainframe revenue within it decreased by 20%. 软件业务营收约 78 亿美元，同比增长 8%。其中，Red Hat 增长 11%，数据业务增长 19%，自动化业务下降 3%。咨询业务营收约 53 亿美元，与上年同期基本持平；基础设施业务营收约 37 亿美元，增长 4%，但其中 IBM Z 大型机收入下降 20%。

The company's operating cash flow for the quarter was approximately $4 billion, free cash flow was approximately $3 billion, and dividends paid to shareholders were approximately $1.6 billion. Free cash flow for the first three quarters totaled approximately $7.8 billion. 公司当季经营现金流约 40 亿美元，自由现金流约 30 亿美元，向股东派息约 16 亿美元。前三季度自由现金流累计约 78 亿美元。

IBM maintained its full-year constant currency revenue growth outlook of 4% to 5% and raised its full-year free cash flow outlook to an increase of over $1 billion year-over-year. The board also approved a quarterly cash dividend of $1.69 per share, with a record date of November 10 and a payment date of December 10. IBM 维持全年固定汇率营收增长 4% 至 5% 的预期，将全年自由现金流展望上调为同比增加超过 10 亿美元。董事会另批准每股 1.69 美元的季度现金股息，登记日为 11 月 10 日，支付日为 12 月 10 日。

item.title: 代码越写越快，测试需求激增：Blacksmith 估值达 10 亿美元
item.guid: 代码越写越快，测试需求激增：Blacksmith-估值达-10-亿美元
item.description:
According to Fortune, Blacksmith, a code testing infrastructure company, completed a $66 million Series C funding round led by Sequoia Capital, reaching a valuation of $1 billion. Founded in 2024, the company provides computing power and software for automated builds and tests before code merges and deployments. 据《财富》报道，代码测试基础设施公司 Blacksmith 完成红杉资本领投的 6600 万美元 C 轮融资，估值达到 10 亿美元。公司成立于 2024 年，为代码合并和部署前的自动构建、测试提供算力与软件。

Blacksmith stated that over 10,000 enterprises use its platform, with clients including Granola, Handshake, Supabase, and LangChain. Weekly validation tasks have increased from 5 million at the beginning of the year to 90 million currently, and annual recurring revenue has grown 17-fold during the same period. Blacksmith 称，使用其平台的企业已超过 1 万家，客户包括 Granola、Handshake、Supabase 和 LangChain。每周验证任务从年初的 500 万次增加到目前的 9000 万次，年经常性收入同期增长 17 倍。

Co-founder and CEO Aditya Jayaprakash stated that AI tools make coding easier, shifting the bottleneck to code verification. Blacksmith purchases its own servers, deploys them in data centers, and reuses software for the repetitive preparation required for testing. 联合创始人兼 CEO Aditya Jayaprakash 表示，AI 工具让写代码变得容易，瓶颈随之转向验证代码。Blacksmith 购买自有服务器，在数据中心部署，并通过软件复用测试所需的重复准备工作。

This round of funding will primarily be used to acquire more computing power. The company also faces tight supply of computing and memory, as well as competition from model vendors who provide their own code verification services. 本轮资金主要将用于购买更多算力。公司也面临计算和内存供应紧张，以及模型厂商自行提供代码验证服务的竞争。

item.title: 💡 何小鹏：自动驾驶应跳过 L3，安全性还要打问号
item.guid: 💡-何小鹏：自动驾驶应跳过-L3，安全性还要打问号
item.description:
He Xiaopeng, Chairman of XPeng Motors, stated at the World Intelligent Connected Vehicles Conference that autonomous driving should skip L3. He believes that the L3 mode shifts safety responsibility to the system, but user experience is not optimized, and whether safety is improved is also questionable. 小鹏汽车董事长何小鹏在世界智能网联汽车大会上表示，自动驾驶应该跳过 L3。他认为，L3 模式将安全责任转移给系统，但用户体验没有得到优化，安全性是否提高也需要打问号。

In his judgment, L3 is essentially closer to an enhanced form of L2. The development path he favors is L2, L4, and a redefined L5. Regulatory systems in various countries must support the evolution of autonomous driving to higher levels, with safety and controllability as prerequisites. 在他的判断中，L3 本质上更接近 L2 的增强形态，他看好的发展路线是 L2、L4，以及重新定义后的 L5。各国监管体系要支撑自动驾驶向更高等级演进，前提应当是安全、可管控。

He Xiaopeng also proposed that the previous definition of L5 primarily focused on technical dimensions, without fully considering safety and scene controllability. 何小鹏还提出，过去的 L5 定义主要从技术维度出发，没有充分从安全、场景可控的角度考量。

Cars provide passive autonomous driving services under certain conditions, while robots may need to actively perform tasks 24 hours a day. Therefore, the future definition of L5 should also be adjusted according to application scenarios. 汽车是在一定条件下提供服务的被动式自动驾驶，机器人则可能需要 24 小时主动执行任务，因此未来 L5 的定义也应随应用场景调整。

Regarding the implementation timeline, he distinguished between two progress paths: technology and policy. From a technical perspective, he expects L4 to be implemented in the second half of 2028; from a regulatory and policy perspective, he estimates the timeline could be between 2028 and 2032. 谈及落地时间，他区分了技术和政策两条进度：从技术层面，他预计 L4 将在 2028 年下半年落地；从法规和政策角度，他判断时间可能在 2028 至 2032 年之间。

item.title: Anthropic 推出 Claude Duet，会主动汇报并在后台继续办事
item.guid: Anthropic-推出-Claude-Duet，会主动汇报并在后台继续办事
item.description:
Anthropic released Claude Duet, transforming Claude into a personal intelligent agent that proactively contacts users and continuously processes tasks. The product is currently open for research preview waitlist, initially targeting US Claude Pro and Max subscribers, offering standalone iOS, Android apps, and a claude.ai web portal. Anthropic 发布 Claude Duet，将 Claude 做成会主动联系用户、持续处理任务的个人智能体。目前产品开放研究预览候补名单，先面向美国 Claude Pro 和 Max 订阅用户，提供独立 iOS、Android App 及 claude.ai 网页入口。

Duet is based on Claude Opus 5.5, leveraging users' existing memories, skills, and application connections. Every morning, it summarizes important items from connected applications, continues to monitor changes throughout the day, and only sends messages when processing or decision-making is required; users can also assign it tasks such as scheduling meetings, creating forecast sheets, building dashboards, or developing web applications, and it will continue working after the user leaves. Duet 基于 Claude Opus 5.5，沿用用户已有的记忆、技能和应用连接。它每天早上汇总已连接应用中的重要事项，白天继续关注变化，只在需要处理或决策时发消息；用户也可交给它安排会议、制作预测表、搭建仪表盘或开发网页应用等任务，离开后它仍会继续工作。

It uses user-connected tools on a cloud computer, and the product page states it supports over 6000 connectors and plugins. Sensitive operations such as sending messages or making payments require prior confirmation; Anthropic states that Duet does not directly see passwords and login tokens, and also includes a specialized information protection classifier to restrict the transmission of sensitive information such as ID documents and credit cards. 它在云端电脑里使用用户连接的工具，产品页称支持超过 6000 个连接器和插件。涉及发送消息、付款等敏感操作时需先取得确认；Anthropic 表示，Duet 不直接看到密码和登录令牌，还加入专门的信息保护分类器，限制身份证件、信用卡等敏感信息外传。

The research preview is included in Pro and Max plans, sharing usage limits with other Claude services, and background checks also consume limits; Team and Enterprise plans are not currently included. The official notice states that the product may still misinterpret conversations, misjudge urgency, or miss messages that arrive between two checks. 研究预览包含在 Pro 和 Max 套餐内，与其他 Claude 使用共享额度，后台检查也会消耗额度；Team 和 Enterprise 暂不包含。官方提示，产品仍可能误读对话、判断错紧急程度，或漏掉两次检查之间到来的消息。

item.title: 国补 3149 元起，荣耀 WIN2 系列开售
item.guid: 国补-3149-元起，荣耀-WIN2-系列开售
item.description:
Honor launched two phones, WIN2 and WIN RT2, in Hangzhou on October 21st, and they went on sale on the same day. The initial subsidized prices start from 4999 yuan and 3149 yuan respectively. This event also introduced WIN Turbo2, WIN Tablet, and WIN Earbuds. 荣耀 10 月 21 日在杭州发布 WIN2、WIN RT2 两款手机，并于发布当天开售，首销国补到手价分别为 4999 元起、3149 元起。本场还带来 WIN Turbo2、WIN 平板及 WIN 耳机。

  • Honor WIN2: Equipped with the 6th generation Snapdragon 8 Super Ultimate Edition, featuring a dual-fan 3D air-net cooling system with a total airflow of 1.19CFM; built-in 10100mAh battery, supporting 100W wired and 80W wireless charging. It also has a 200-megapixel main camera, USB 3.2, 3D ultrasonic fingerprint sensor, and a customizable gaming WIN key. 荣耀 WIN2：搭载第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版，配备双风扇立体风网散热系统，总风量为 1.19CFM；内置 10100mAh 电池，支持 100W 有线和 80W 无线充电。另有 2 亿像素主摄、USB 3.2、3D 超声波指纹和可自定义的电竞 WIN 键。
  • Honor WIN RT2: Equipped with the 5th generation Snapdragon 8 Ultimate Edition, featuring the same Uranus fan as the WIN2, and an increased battery capacity of 12070mAh. Both phones feature a 2K 185Hz dual-core Oasis display, LPDDR5X Ultra memory, and UFS 4.1 flash storage. 荣耀 WIN RT2：搭载第五代骁龙 8 至尊版，配备与 WIN2 同款的天王星风扇，电池增至 12070mAh。两款手机均采用 2K 185Hz 双芯绿洲屏，以及 LPDDR5X Ultra 内存和 UFS 4.1 闪存。
  • Honor WIN Turbo2: Pre-sales have begun, and it will go on sale on October 30th at 10:08 AM, with the subsidized price starting from 2251.65 yuan. 荣耀 WIN Turbo2：已开启预售，将于 10 月 30 日 10:08 开售，国补到手价 2251.65 元起。
  • Honor WIN Tablet: Features an 8.4-inch 240Hz OLED screen, equipped with the 5th generation Snapdragon 8 Ultimate Edition, air-cooling system, and a 10000mAh battery. 荣耀 WIN 平板：采用 8.4 英寸 240Hz OLED 屏，搭载第五代骁龙 8 至尊版、风冷散热系统和 10000mAh 电池。
  • Honor WIN Earbuds: Support 40ms low latency and 55dB noise reduction, and are Hi-Res certified. 荣耀 WIN 耳机：支持 40ms 低延迟和 55dB 降噪，并通过 Hi-Res 认证。

WIN2 will also launch a professional esports co-branded edition for "Delta Force: Hawk Ops", with e-commerce pre-orders starting on October 30th and a planned release in November. WIN2 还将推出《三角洲行动》职业赛事联名款，10 月 30 日开启电商预约，计划 11 月登场。

item.title: Flowtica 获新融资，磁吸墨水屏硬件 Verso 计划 12 月出货
item.guid: Flowtica-获新融资，磁吸墨水屏硬件-Verso-计划-12-月出货
item.description:
According to 36Kr, AI hardware company Flowtica has completed a new round of financing worth tens of millions of yuan, with investors including Vertex Ventures, Source Code Capital, 5Y Capital, and Clear Water Bay Fund. Its magnetic e-ink screen hardware, Verso, began accepting pre-orders this week, with the first batch of mass-produced products scheduled for shipment in December. 据硬氪报道，AI 硬件公司 Flowtica 已完成新一轮数千万元融资，投资方包括祥峰资本、源码资本、五源资本和清水湾基金。其磁吸式墨水屏硬件 Verso 本周开始预收定金，首批量产产品计划于 12 月出货。

Verso can be attached to the back of a phone, is 6.5mm thick, weighs 78g, and features an always-on e-ink screen, physical buttons, a Type-C port, a four-microphone array, and bone conduction sensors. The screen displays schedules, to-do lists, and AI-extracted information, while the side buttons support blind recording and AI invocation. Verso 可贴在手机背面，厚 6.5mm、重 78g，配备常显墨水屏、实体按键、Type-C 接口、四麦克风阵列及骨传导传感器。屏幕用于呈现日程、待办及 AI 提炼的信息，侧边按键支持盲操录音和调用 AI。

Founder Rian explained in an interview that voice is suitable for inputting commands, while screens facilitate quick scanning of results. According to the team's product design, meeting minutes will be linked with personal long-term memory to generate task breakdowns, pre-meeting briefings, and follow-up drafts; the company previously launched the Scribe voice recorder, and Verso is its second hardware product. 创始人 Rian 在采访中解释，语音适合输入指令，屏幕便于快速扫读结果。按团队的产品设计，会议记录将与个人长期记忆联动，再生成待办拆解、会前简报和跟进草稿；公司此前已推出录音笔 Scribe，Verso 是其第二款硬件。

item.title: 戴森推出水光直板夹，拉直头发时用冷凝管降温
item.guid: 戴森推出水光直板夹，拉直头发时用冷凝管降温
item.description:
Dyson launched the Corrale CoolShine hair straightener in mainland China, adding a detachable cooling condenser tube alongside its flexible plates, allowing hair to cool down simultaneously after being styled by the hot plates. 戴森在中国大陆推出 Corrale CoolShine 水光直板夹，在柔性弹板之外加入可拆卸的散热冷凝管，让头发经过热夹板塑型后同步降温。

According to product materials provided by Dyson, the accessory uses a sealed copper tube, where a small amount of water evaporates to dissipate heat, reducing the time heat remains on the hair strands. The flexible plates, through deformation, wrap and gather hair strands, allowing the hair to be evenly stressed and reducing repeated clamping. 据戴森提供的产品材料，配件采用密封铜管，内部少量水在蒸发过程中带走热量，减少热量停留在发丝上的时间。柔性弹板则通过形变包裹并聚拢发束，让头发均匀受力，减少反复拉夹。

The new device offers four temperature settings: 145℃, 165℃, 185℃, and 210℃, completing preheating in about 15 seconds. It has a net weight of approximately 390 grams including accessories and supports universal voltage. Dyson claims that compared to unstyled hair, shine can be boosted by up to 154% after styling. 新机提供 145℃、165℃、185℃ 和 210℃ 四档温度，约 15 秒完成预热，含配件净重约 390 克，并支持全球通用电压。戴森称，与未经造型的头发相比，造型后光泽度最高可提升 154%。

The product will be available in mainland China on October 20th, offering two color options: Dawn Pink and Crystal Purple. 产品于 10 月 20 日在中国大陆发售，提供晨曦粉和晶耀紫两种配色。

item.title: 生数科技公开 Motubrain 2.0 训练流程，计划连续直播半个月
item.guid: 生数科技公开-Motubrain-2.0-训练流程，计划连续直播半个月
item.description:
The Shengshu Technology World Model team announced that on October 21st, they will begin a public live stream of the entire Motubrain 2.0 training process, planned to last half a month, demonstrating the embodied model's journey from training and testing to capability iteration. The team stated that Motubrain 2.0 will soon be open-sourced, but the specific open-source date has not yet been announced. 生数科技世界模型团队宣布，10 月 21 日开启 Motubrain 2.0 训练全流程公开直播，计划持续半个月，展示具身模型从训练、测试到能力迭代的过程。团队表示，Motubrain 2.0 即将开源，目前尚未公布具体开源日期。

The Motubrain series focuses on robot tasks, researching the generalization of capabilities across different tasks, scenarios, and robot embodiments. This live stream covers four stages: the pre-training stage observes the impact of training scale on performance and zero-shot generalization; the post-training stage enhances the execution capability for specific tasks; the Agent task execution stage explores the transfer of existing experience to other tasks; and the Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) stage investigates whether the model can evaluate and improve its own actions based on execution feedback. Motubrain 系列面向机器人任务，研究不同任务、场景和机器人本体之间的能力泛化。这次直播覆盖四个环节：预训练阶段观察训练规模对性能与零样本泛化能力的影响；后训练阶段提高具体任务的执行能力；Agent 任务执行阶段探索已有经验向其他任务迁移；递归自我改进（RSI）阶段则研究模型能否依据执行反馈，评估并改进自身行动。

The team stated that the relevant research is still in the exploratory phase, and specific effects await subsequent experiments and evaluation. The official Live Lab page already displays training loss, training steps, model evaluation curves, and 4-way camera inputs. Evaluation tasks include hanging headphones, organizing drawers, picking up and handing over items, and wiping whiteboards. 团队称，相关研究仍处于探索阶段，具体效果有待后续实验与评测验证。官方 Live Lab 页面已展示训练损失、训练步数、模型评测曲线及 4 路摄像头入口，评测任务包括挂耳机、整理抽屉、拾取交接物品和擦白板。

item.title: 宇树发布 H2-X「功夫传奇」，最长续航约 8 小时
item.guid: 宇树发布-H2-X「功夫传奇」，最长续航约-8-小时
item.description:
Yesterday, Unitree Robotics released the humanoid robot H2-X "Kung Fu Legend Guardian". 昨天，宇树科技发布人形机器人 H2-X「功夫传奇 守护」。

According to the introduction, the H2-X provides services and guardianship with powerful performance, boasting a maximum battery life of approximately 8 hours, and reminds users to use the robot safely and friendly. The model shown on the video cover is Unitree H2-X. 据介绍，H2-X 以强劲性能提供服务和守护，最长续航时间约 8 小时，并提醒使用者安全、友好地使用机器人。该视频封面中的型号为 Unitree H2-X。

Unitree officials previously announced that the 2026 World Physical AI Conference and Unitree Partner Ecosystem Conference will be held on October 22nd, and the H2-X was unveiled the day before the conference. 宇树官方此前公布，2026 世界物理 AI 大会暨宇树合作伙伴生态大会将于 10 月 22 日举行，H2-X 在大会前一天公开。

item.title: 徕卡 Q3 43 推出 F1 特别版，碳纤维握柄搭配专属赛车色彩
item.guid: 徕卡-Q3-43-推出-F1-特别版，碳纤维握柄搭配专属赛车色彩
item.description:
Leica and Formula 1 announced a licensing partnership, launching the Q3 43 Formula 1 Special Edition camera, available from October 21st through Leica stores, official online shops, and professional retailers. 徕卡与 Formula 1 宣布授权合作，推出 Q3 43 Formula 1 特别版相机，10 月 21 日起通过徕卡门店、官网商店及专业零售商发售。

The special edition brings racing materials to the camera: the body is covered with black non-slip Microvelour material similar to a racing steering wheel, and the grip, thumb rest, and soft shutter button use German-made carbon fiber components. The top cover, lens cap, and strap feature F1 and Leica logos, while the soft shutter button and the right function key on the thumb rest use F1 red. 特别版将赛车材质带到相机上：机身包覆与赛车方向盘类似的黑色防滑 Microvelour 材料，握柄、指托和软快门按钮采用德国手工制作的碳纤维部件。顶盖、镜头盖及背带带有 F1 与徕卡标识，软快门按钮和指托右侧功能键则使用 F1 红色。

The camera also adds an exclusive "Formula 1" Leica Look, presenting a racetrack atmosphere through higher contrast and saturation. Users can transfer the color style to the camera via the Leica FOTOS App, previewing the effect in the viewfinder during shooting and applying it directly to JPEGs. 相机还新增专属「Formula 1」Leica Look，通过更高对比度与饱和度呈现赛道氛围。用户可经 Leica FOTOS App 将色彩风格传到相机，拍摄时就在取景器中预览效果，并直接应用于 JPEG。

Core specifications continue from the standard version: 60-megapixel full-frame CMOS, Maestro IV processor, APO-Summicron 43mm f/2 ASPH. lens, and up to 8K video recording. The accompanying carbon fiber grip supports wireless charging and Arca-Swiss quick-release structure. 核心规格延续标准版：6000 万像素全画幅 CMOS、Maestro IV 处理器、APO-Summicron 43mm f/2 ASPH. 镜头及最高 8K 视频录制。配套碳纤维握柄支持无线充电和 Arca-Swiss 快装结构。

item.title: 《绝地求生》厂商开放 Raon-1 mini 模型，量化版可在单张 RTX 5090 运行
item.guid: 《绝地求生》厂商开放-Raon-1-mini-模型，量化版可在单张-RTX-5090-运行
item.description:
KRAFTON, the developer of "PUBG," unveiled a preview version of its self-developed language model, Raon-1 mini, focusing on Korean dialogue, programming, and agent tasks. The model has a total of 28.8 billion parameters, with approximately 4.3 billion parameters activated per token processing, and natively supports a 262,144 token context. 《绝地求生》开发商 KRAFTON 公开自研语言模型 Raon-1 mini 预览版，重点面向韩语对话、编程和智能体任务。模型总参数 288 亿，每次处理 token 激活约 43 亿参数，原生支持 262144 token 上下文。

It adopts a hybrid attention architecture: 18 of its 25 layers use RDA improved based on Kimi Delta Attention, while the other 7 layers are full attention; the team also used Raon-mHC to simplify DeepSeek's hyper-connection mechanism to reduce training computation. 它采用混合注意力架构：25 层中有 18 层使用基于 Kimi Delta Attention 改进的 RDA，另 7 层为完整注意力；团队还用 Raon-mHC 简化 DeepSeek 的超连接机制，以降低训练计算量。

In official self-tests, the SWE-Verified code repair score was 70.8, but Terminal-Bench Lite was 47.0, indicating performance differences across various tasks. The model offers an NVFP4 quantized version, which can perform inference on a single RTX 5090 with 32GB of VRAM, and also supports llama.cpp and MLX on Apple silicon. 官方自测中，SWE-Verified 代码修复得分为 70.8，但 Terminal-Bench Lite 为 47.0，不同任务表现存在差异。模型提供 NVFP4 量化版，可在拥有 32GB 显存的单张 RTX 5090 上推理，也支持 llama.cpp 和 Apple 芯片上的 MLX。

Downloaded model weights and components are under the Apache 2.0 license, requiring prior access application; official hosted API and experience services have separate terms. This is still a preview version, and specifications and test results may be adjusted. 下载的模型权重及组件采用 Apache 2.0 许可，需先申请访问；官方托管 API 和体验服务另有条款。这仍是预览版本，规格与测试结果可能调整。

item.title: DGX Spark 可组成 8 台集群，统一内存最高达 1TB
item.guid: DGX-Spark-可组成-8-台集群，统一内存最高达-1TB
item.description:
NVIDIA updated its local AI products and software at the GTC Berlin conference: DGX Spark can now be manually configured into a cluster of up to 8 devices, interconnected using built-in ConnectX-7 networking, with a unified memory total reaching up to 1TB. 英伟达在 GTC 柏林大会更新本地 AI 产品与软件：DGX Spark 现在可手动配置最多 8 台设备组成集群，使用内置 ConnectX-7 网络互联，统一内存总量最高达到 1TB。

This cluster is designed for small development teams, allowing multiple users to connect to the same model simultaneously, run larger models, longer contexts, and multiple agents. NVIDIA Sync Model Launcher is scheduled to be released later this month, enabling the download of suitable models and containers in single-machine or cluster configurations, and integration with OpenCode. 这套集群面向小型开发团队，可让多人同时连接同一模型，运行更大模型、更长上下文和多个智能体。NVIDIA Sync Model Launcher 计划本月晚些时候推出，可按单机或集群配置下载适合的模型和容器，并接入 OpenCode。

In terms of hardware, the 64GB version of DGX Spark will be progressively launched through partner channels starting October 23. The higher-end DGX Station already offers 748GB of consistent memory, with a Windows version planned for release by partners in December, designed to establish workflows between local models and specialized manufacturing software. 硬件方面，64GB 版 DGX Spark 将于 10 月 23 日从合作伙伴渠道陆续推出。更高定位的 DGX Station 已提供 748GB 一致性内存，Windows 版计划 12 月由合作伙伴推出，用于在本地模型与制造业专业软件之间建立工作流。

The October software update, launched concurrently, also adds Wi-Fi Assistant to DGX Spark, making it easier for devices to switch networks in display-less appliance mode. 同场上线的十月软件更新还为 DGX Spark 加入 Wi-Fi Assistant，便于设备在无显示器的 appliance 模式下切换网络。

item.title: 星巴克 10 月 22 日起全国实行「消费入座」，将投入超 3 亿元升级服务
item.guid: 星巴克-10-月-22-日起全国实行「消费入座」，将投入超-3-亿元升级服务
item.description:
Starbucks China will implement a "consume-to-sit" policy nationwide starting October 22, with relevant signage displayed in stores. The company stated that it will provide unified service guidelines to store partners, adhere to friendly communication principles during implementation, and properly handle reasonable urgent needs and special circumstances; customers needing assistance, such as pregnant women or those with mobility issues, will be given priority. 星巴克中国将于 10 月 22 日起在全国实行「消费入座」，门店会摆放相关提示牌。公司表示，会向门店伙伴提供统一服务指引，执行时遵循友好沟通原则，并妥善处理合理的突发需求及特殊情况；遇到孕妇、行动不便者等需要帮助的顾客，会优先给予帮助。

Announced alongside this store space policy is a new fiscal year service upgrade plan. Starbucks China announced that in fiscal year 2027, it will invest an additional over 300 million yuan to increase staffing during peak hours and at Reserve bars, upgrade digital intelligence systems and core equipment, and renovate approximately 1,000 stores. 与这项门店空间规则同时公布的，还有新财年服务升级计划。星巴克中国宣布，2027 财年将新增投入超 3 亿元，用于增加高峰时段及臻选吧台人力、升级数智化系统和核心设备，并改造约 1000 家门店。

Among these, nearly half of the stores nationwide will increase staffing during peak hours, adding over 200,000 service hours per month, with an additional over 70,000 hours for Reserve bars. Smart mobile POS machines with over 70 new features will be launched in phases starting January 2027. 其中，全国近半数门店将增加高峰时段人力，每月新增超过 20 万小时服务时间，臻选吧台另增超过 7 万小时。新增 70 多项功能的智能移动 POS 机将自 2027 年 1 月起分阶段上线。

Service guarantees also include: customers can have their drinks remade for free if they are not satisfied; if an order is placed at the wrong pickup store, the customer can have it remade at their current store with a valid order. 服务保障还包括：顾客对饮品不满意可免费重做；下错取单门店时，可凭有效订单由所在门店协助重新制作。

item.title: 美国沃尔玛为 AI 代购设独立档案，用户可限额并随时撤销授权
item.guid: 美国沃尔玛为-AI-代购设独立档案，用户可限额并随时撤销授权
item.description:
Walmart announced the launch of Agent Profiles, Agent Gateway, and dedicated agent terms of use for AI personal shoppers, covering Walmart and Sam's Club stores. Users can choose their preferred AI applications to purchase items and manage the permissions of each agent separately. 沃尔玛宣布为 AI 代购推出 Agent Profiles、Agent Gateway 和专门的智能体使用条款，覆盖沃尔玛与山姆会员商店。用户可以选择自己习惯的 AI 应用代买商品，同时单独管理每个智能体的权限。

Agent Profiles are scheduled to launch in the next month. Each agent will have an independent profile within the customer's account, with proxy purchase orders displayed separately from personal orders; users can request per-transaction confirmation, set spending limits, and revoke authorization at any time. Agent Profiles 计划在接下来一个月上线。每个智能体将在顾客账号内拥有独立档案，代购订单与本人订单分开显示；用户可要求逐笔确认，也可设定消费限额，并随时关闭授权。

The Agent Gateway, already in testing, connects agents with store systems via the MCP protocol, allowing them to directly search for products and complete purchases, reducing lag and errors caused by simulating browser operations. Walmart states that the system can help agents find frequently purchased items without disclosing the user's complete shopping history. 已进入测试的 Agent Gateway 通过 MCP 协议连接智能体与商店系统，让它们直接查找商品和完成购买，减少模拟浏览器操作造成的卡顿和错误。沃尔玛称，系统可帮助智能体找到用户常买的商品，而不必向它披露完整购物历史。

The terms prohibit agents from acting beyond the customer's intent, modifying the customer's payment method, or accessing information not required for the task; violating agents will be banned. 条款禁止智能体超出顾客意图采取行动、修改顾客支付方式或读取任务所不需要的信息，违规智能体将被封禁。

Walmart also stated that the same product will be displayed at the same price to AI agents and direct shopping customers, with applicable discounts and fees listed before payment. 沃尔玛还表示，同一商品面向 AI 智能体与直接购物顾客展示相同价格，适用优惠及费用会在付款前列明。

item.title: 《沙丘 3》内地定档 12 月 31 日
item.guid: 《沙丘-3》内地定档-12-月-31-日
item.description:
"Dune 3" announced its release in mainland China on December 31. IMAX officially released the scheduling information simultaneously, stating that the film was shot with IMAX "special features," including 71 minutes of exclusive aspect ratio, and accompanied by a custom mix. 《沙丘 3》宣布将于 12 月 31 日在中国内地上映。IMAX 官方同步发布定档信息，称影片采用 IMAX「特制」拍摄，包含 71 分钟独家画幅，并配以定制混音。

The film is directed by Denis Villeneuve and is the final chapter of his "Dune" trilogy, continuing to explore Paul Atreides' fate after gaining power. Timothée Chalamet and Zendaya, playing Paul and Chani, move towards opposite ends of destiny in the story, and the return of a deceased acquaintance brings new mysteries to Paul. 影片由丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦执导，是其《沙丘》三部曲的最终章，继续围绕保罗·厄崔迪掌握权力后的命运展开。提莫西·查拉梅与赞达亚饰演的保罗、契妮在故事中走向命运的两端，逝去故人的归来也给保罗带来新的谜题。

The film is produced by Legendary Pictures and Warner Bros. Discovery, with its North American release set for December 18. 影片由传奇影业与华纳兄弟探索集团打造，北美定于 12 月 18 日上映。

item.title: 《欢乐合唱团》将重启，Disney+ 与 Hulu 正式预订新剧
item.guid: 《欢乐合唱团》将重启，Disney+-与-Hulu-正式预订新剧
item.description:
"Glee" will return with a new series. Disney+ and Hulu have officially ordered a reboot, with 20th Television, the original show's producer, still at the helm. 《欢乐合唱团》（Glee）将以新剧回归。Disney+ 与 Hulu 已正式预订重启版，制作方仍是原剧的 20th Television。

According to The Hollywood Reporter, creator Ryan Murphy stated in August that he was considering a reboot and revealed in September that he had already written a new version of the script with original series co-creators Brad Falchuk and Ian Brennan. The current order announcement has not yet revealed the cast and production team, as related creator agreements are still being finalized. 据《好莱坞报道者》报道，主创瑞恩·墨菲在 8 月表示考虑重启，并在 9 月透露已与原剧共同创作者布拉德·法尔查克、伊恩·布伦南写好新版本剧本。此次预订公告尚未公布演员和制作团队，相关主创协议仍在敲定。

The original series aired on Fox from 2009 to 2015, spanning 6 seasons, and revolved around a high school choir in Ohio. It combined pop song covers, campus growth, and character relationships, winning 6 Emmy Awards. The original version is currently available on Hulu. 原剧于 2009 至 2015 年在 Fox 播出，共 6 季，围绕俄亥俄州一所高中的合唱团展开。它把流行歌曲翻唱、校园成长与人物关系结合，曾获得 6 座艾美奖，原版目前可在 Hulu 观看。

item.title: 汤姆·克鲁斯将获 AFI 终身成就奖，明年 4 月举行致敬典礼
item.guid: 汤姆·克鲁斯将获-AFI-终身成就奖，明年-4-月举行致敬典礼
item.description:
The American Film Institute (AFI) announced that Tom Cruise will receive the 52nd AFI Life Achievement Award. The tribute ceremony is scheduled for April 24, 2027, at the Dolby Theatre in Hollywood, and will review his screen works and his career as an actor and producer. 美国电影学会 AFI 宣布，汤姆·克鲁斯将获第 52 届 AFI 终身成就奖。致敬典礼定于 2027 年 4 月 24 日在好莱坞杜比剧院举行，将回顾他的银幕作品及演员、制片人生涯。

AFI Board of Trustees Chair Kathleen Kennedy stated that Cruise holds a deep belief in film's ability to unite audiences, and his dedication has made him an important global representative of American cinema. This award annually selects one recipient, focusing on long-term creative contributions and the extent to which their work has been recognized by peers, critics, and audiences. AFI 董事会主席凯瑟琳·肯尼迪表示，克鲁斯对电影能够凝聚观众抱有深厚信念，其投入也使他成为美国电影在全球的重要代表。这个奖项每年选出一位获奖者，关注长期创作贡献，以及作品获得同行、评论界与观众认可的程度。

Cruise's representative works span 'Top Gun,' 'Mission: Impossible,' 'Rain Man,' 'A Few Good Men,' and 'Minority Report,' among others. He was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Actor for 'Born on the Fourth of July' and 'Jerry Maguire,' for Best Supporting Actor for 'Magnolia,' and for Best Picture as a producer for 'Top Gun: Maverick.' 克鲁斯的代表作横跨《壮志凌云》《碟中谍》《雨人》《好人寥寥》和《少数派报告》等。他曾凭《生于七月四日》《甜心先生》获得奥斯卡最佳男主角提名，凭《木兰花》获得最佳男配角提名，并以《壮志凌云：独行侠》制片人身份获最佳影片提名。

He will also receive an honorary Academy Award in 2025. Recent AFI honorees include Nicole Kidman, Francis Ford Coppola, and Eddie Murphy. 他还在 2025 年获得奥斯卡荣誉奖。AFI 近年的获奖者包括妮可·基德曼、弗朗西斯·福特·科波拉和艾迪·墨菲。
